specs.name: codemode

parameters.description: Named JSON data fields exposed as read-only inputs in JavaScript.
Optional kernel-issued token for a return-only receipt replay.

json_examples: {"tool":"codemode","args":{"code":"const result = await tools.read_file({path:inputs.path}); const file = unwrap(result); return file.text;","inputs":{"path":"app.py"}}}
specs.description:
Write an async JavaScript function body using tools.* and return its JSON result explicitly. Use return null for an intentional empty result. Normal authorization applies. Returning modified data does not persist it; invoke the declared action tool to change external state. Calls return Result<T>; use unwrap(await tools.NAME(...)) to obtain T. Access only fields declared for that tool's output schema. Await all tool/store/load calls. console.log/error fail; only return delivers data. No direct filesystem, process, network, shell or recursive CodeMode access. Preserve argument strings exactly, including whether quote characters are present. Put task data (paths, search queries, file contents) in inputs, not JS string literals. Read it as inputs.name; inputs is immutable JSON data, never executable source. Example inputs={"path": "app.py"}; JavaScript: const result = await tools.read_file({path:inputs.path}); const file = unwrap(result); return file.text;
Multiline data arguments: {"code": "return inputs.text;", "inputs": {"text": "first\nsecond\n"}}

specs.name: edit

parameters.description: Complete file text; preserve unrelated content. Prefer replacements for focused edits.

Only for content mode; omit this field with replacements. Use the latest complete read_file receipt reference. The reference belongs to the original outer Result; unwrap returns only file data. CodeMode example: const base=await tools.read_file({path:inputs.path}); const data=unwrap(base); then pass base.result_ref as base_result_ref.
Copy only task-declared fields from complete browser receipts. Supply path and the original complete read's base_result_ref; do not supply content or changes.

json_examples:
{"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"app.py","replacements":[{"old_string":"def process():
    return old_value
","new_string":"def process():
    return new_value
"}]}}
specs.description: Edit existing files with up to 8 exact replacements, preserving unrelated code. For replacements, omit content and base_result_ref. Create new files with content. For a whole-file update, use content plus base_result_ref. base_result_ref must be a complete read_file receipt from this task; changed versions are rejected. Include surrounding lines and the target text together in old_string of the same replacement so it matches one location uniquely. Preserve those surrounding lines in new_string. Separate replacement objects do not scope one another.

specs.name: find_references
specs.description: Find bounded lexical reference hints for a simple symbol. This is not semantic resolution; use read_file before editing.

specs.name: grep

parameters.description: One rg glob string, not an array. Combine alternatives with braces, e.g. *.{py,ts}.

specs.description: Search file contents for literal text before reading when the location is unknown. Uses packaged ripgrep. Defaults to literal, case-insensitive matching; set literal=false for regex, case_sensitive=true for exact case, include for one positive glob, exclude for positive globs to omit, and before_context/after_context for surrounding lines. Use rg braces for alternatives, e.g. include='*.{py,ts}'; comma-separated globs are not alternatives. Globs are relative to the workspace root even when path narrows the search. Exclude directories with an array such as exclude=['src/vendor/**']. Searches hidden and ignored files within the admitted workspace scope, excluding build/VCS directories and symlinks. CodeMode value is a page object with matches and explicit coverage; column_byte is one-based UTF-8 bytes. Read matched files for context.

specs.name: list_dir
specs.description: List files in a directory.

specs.name: open_url
specs.description: read a page's text; for PDFs, pages selects bounded page ranges

specs.name: read_file
specs.description: Read one file. Large files are returned in complete-line pages. In CodeMode, value is an object: value.text is the page text (a string), with start_line, end_line, total_lines, next_offset and text_complete metadata.

specs.name: source_search
specs.description: search within a source already opened with open_url; returns locators, offsets, and PDF pages

specs.name: web_search
specs.description: search the web for ranked results
